line_convention: line = the line eo-workflow-lint reports for the finding, i.e. the first line of the call expression (ast lineno).

cases.human_review_note: Expert reference. c02_l2_sr (lines 4-44) renames bands and applies the documented scale/offset list-wise; c02_sr_ndi clamps inputs with max(0) before normalizedDifference (line 96) with a comment explaining that normalizedDifference returns nodata for negative inputs. The negative-input choice is explicit, so no EWL203 is expected; no other targeted anti-pattern is present.

NDVI.py filters COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED to 2022-01-01..2022-12-31 (lines 17-20) and cloud-masks with select('QA60').eq(0) (line 33). QA60 cloud polygons were not produced from 2022-01-25 until February 2024, so for most of that year the mask removes nothing: the interval overlaps, but is not contained by, the documented QA60 gap, which is exactly EWL502. app.py (negative control): Sentinel-2 indices are computed with band arithmetic, not Landsat normalizedDifference; every reduceRegion passes scale=30 (lines 261-264, 451-454, 574-577); QA60 is never used; dates come from the request or a loop, so nothing is expected. The repository also vendors a Python virtualenv (backend/gee_env2), excluded from the sweep.

expected.scope_gap: bands are renamed to nir/red/green by select(list, list) with per-platform ee.Dictionary lookups and scaled with ee.Image.constant lists in openet_image.py:276-301; the normalizedDifference call is in another module. Band identity and scale state cannot be proven statically

cases.human_review_note: openet_image.py:276-301 applies the documented C2 L2 SR scale/offset to Landsat 4-9 SR bands renamed to standard names; openet_landsat.ndvi (line 20) and ndwi (line 97) call normalizedDifference on that scaled SR without clamping, then unmask(0), so pixels with a negative input silently become 0. Unlike openet-core (max(0) with an explanatory comment) the choice is not explicit. EWL203 semantics apply, but the shape is outside the static model, so the expected tool result is PASS and the case is reported as coverage-unresolved.
